subject: truck2077
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: futuristic militarized truck from 2077.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk, extremely intricate.

spec.name: Warhound MX-77 Armored Truck
spec.description: A low-poly cyberpunk 2077 militarized 6x6 truck with a wedge armored cab, neon-lit hull, weapon turret and a modular cargo bay.
spec.layout: A heavy 6x6 truck facing +Z. Front: sloped angular armored cab with a slit visor windshield, a dozer-wedge bumper with a winch, cyan neon underglow strips and a roof light bar. Mid: a low-slung armored chassis with side skirts, hex armor plates, panel seams and rivets, fuel and battery pods, amber hazard chevrons and drawn emblems/decals. Rear: a boxy modular cargo bay with a ramp, roof rails, antenna masts and a rotating roof turret with twin barrels over the cargo front. Six chunky wheels (two front steered, four rear on a tandem axle) with big hex hubs, neon-ringed rims and mud-painted tires. Wheels, hull and turret form a dark gunmetal body with yellow hazard trim, magenta and cyan neon accents. Every surface is faceted and blocky, with painted wear: soot near exhausts, mud at the bottom, pale top highlights. Glowing parts: neon strips, headlights, visor, turret sensor, tail lights.

parts.builds: Armored lower hull between the axles, from rear bumper to front bumper: the main frame beam box, side skirts with hex plate paint (panelled gunmetal), under-body rails, fuel and battery pods, exhaust stacks with soot paint behind the cab, yellow-black hazard chevron stripes (SVG texture) on skirts, cyan underglow neon strips along the bottom, a dozer-wedge front bumper with a winch drum, tow hooks, skid plates, mud paint gradient at the bottom, plus fender arches over each wheel. Includes mid and rear mud flaps and a rear bumper with red tail lights (glow).
parts.attaches: Top face at chassisTop height 1.35 carries cab at cabBase and cargo at cargoBase; wheel arches surround the axle mounts; rear end holds the ramp hinge at rampHinge.

parts.builds: Sloped angular armored cab: faceted wedge body with a heavy lowered roof, slit visor windshield (dark glass with a cyan HUD-line SVG decal), side armored windows with shutters, door panels with seams and handles, a drawn emblem (skull-hound badge) on the doors and hood, hood vents, a roof light bar with amber and white glow lights, headlights (glow) and a grille with neon magenta strips, side mirrors on arms, roof antennas, a roof sensor dome, a tow-cable rack. Panelled hullLight paint with wear: pale top highlights, soot at the vents.
parts.attaches: Sits on the chassis at cabBase and cabRear heights of 1.35; the bumper front meets the cab nose near bumperFront; the rear wall meets cargoFront.

parts.builds: Modular armored cargo bay behind the cab: a box container with ribbed panelled walls, olive and hull plates, corner posts, rivets, roof rails and tie-downs, two roof hatches, side fuel and storage lockers with hazard stripes, glowing cyan vent grilles, an amber warning beacon, rear drop-down ramp (separate piece on the ramp joint with hazard stripes and hydraulic pistons), rear double door seams, a drawn unit number and a stencil label, antenna masts with magenta tips, cable conduits down the sides, and a mount ring plate on the roof front for the turret at turretRing.
parts.attaches: Sits on chassisTop 1.35; front wall touches cab rear at cargoFront; roof front plate meets the turret base at turretRing; the ramp hinges at rampHinge.

parts.builds: Roof weapon turret: a rotating faceted base ring on turretYaw, an armored angular housing with hex plates, twin barrels with shrouds, muzzle brakes and cooling fins on gunPitch, an ammo box with a belt feed (chain of small links), a gunner shield, a glowing cyan targeting sensor and a magenta laser designator, a side missile pod with four tubes and warning stripes, a drawn kill-mark tally, and rim lights. Barrels point forward +Z in the rest pose.
parts.attaches: Base ring is centred at turretRing and sits on the cargo roof plate; the pitch pivot is at gunPitch.

parts.builds: Six wheels, each on its own wheel joint with the axle along x: chunky low-poly tires (lathe or cylinder with 12 sides, mud paint on the treads and a tread-block pattern, dark sidewalls with white lettering SVG), big hex-bolt armored rims with a neon cyan ring (glow), hub caps with bolts, brake discs and calipers visible inside, and axle housings with differentials, leaf spring and shock absorbers linking each axle to the chassis. Axles run at the frontAxle, midAxle and rearAxle mounts, tires radius about 0.62, width 0.5.
parts.attaches: Wheel joints sit at the axle mounts at x = ±1.3; axle housings and springs reach up to the chassis underside at about y 0.9; fender arches belong to the chassis.

calls.reasoning:
I'm planning a single buildCargo function, using loosely-typed parameters for the context pieces to avoid conflicts with any existing type declarations.

I'm sketching out the container's dimensions and structure — main body box with panelled hull plates, vertical ribs along the walls, corner posts, a roofline with rails and stanchions, tie-downs, hatches with hinges, and side lockers with hazard-stripe textures and glowing vent grilles, all built from simple boxes kept within the size budget.

I'm also working out the beacon and ramp: an amber glowing cylinder with a dome on the rear roof, and a hinged cargo ramp whose closed position needs careful placement so the door panel fits within the container's bounding box without poking out.

I'm adding more details now: piston rods connecting the ramp to the body, door seams and handles on the ramp, a stenciled unit number decal, magenta-tipped antenna masts at the rear corners, conduit rods with clamps along the sides, and a mounting ring plate near the roof.

Working out the turret ring dimensions, body-to-roof transition heights, and the front wall placement before writing the actual construction code for the parts and materials.

Setting up a box-building helper function, then planning merged rivet geometry using mergeGeometries for efficient low-poly sphere clusters along the rib panels.

Now I'm defining wall paint using countershading between hull colors plus a muddy gradient near the base, and sketching a hazard-stripe SVG texture with diagonal yellow and dark stripes.

I'm adding a vent texture with cyan slats on a dark background, then working out the ramp piston rods with proper bone assignments, roof rail posts along the rear, and hatch plates positioned at specific heights and widths.

Now I'm placing small ring tie-downs along the roof edges, a beacon cylinder with an amber glow sphere near the back, and antenna masts with glowing magenta tips capped just under the height limit.
